source_location_note: Paths identify immutable retained originals in the main local project workspace. Generated results are not all versioned or present in integration worktrees. This snapshot rechecks their hashes and aggregates outcomes; it does not rerun original audits or candidates.

pool_diagnostic.limitation: Survivor-conditioned final versions with shared selected ancestry and unequal repairs; not twelve independent projects.

assessment: A concrete negative result for the tested four-cheap-candidate/strong-reviewer portfolio on the harder two synthetic applications: zero of six accepted and three of six stopped early, against three of six accepted with a strong builder and common reviewer protocol.
The earlier easier portfolio success establishes feasibility on those fixtures; its one-run lead per comparator does not establish superiority.
The latest candidate-formation pilot does not show independent breadth beating sequential formation; sequential accepts four of four, both independent arms three of four.
Every comparison is a small synthetic development sample with repeated domains. Report descriptive outcomes, not population p-values, calibrated Elo, or a general swarm advantage/disadvantage.
None of these experiments isolates live gossip transport versus orchestrator placement. A 20-role live project-quality comparison and independent held-out-family confirmation remain untested.
Infrastructure checks, semantic reviews, scripted fixtures and mutant detection are not additional model-quality samples.
research_process_assessment: Recent harness work has outpaced new comparative samples. Passing infrastructure checks does not answer the scientific question.
next_evidence_needed: A predeclared matched live gossip-versus-orchestrator comparison on accepted whole-project completion and recovery.
The required larger 20-role live quality comparison.
scope_note: This status aggregation neither changes experimental contracts nor authorizes a new cohort; all unfinished study obligations remain.
